retrievalProfile.description: A warm-toned, urban masculine portrait featuring a muscular subject against a distressed architectural background with high-contrast side lighting.
triggerTerms: sepia toned muscular man in fedora
excludeWhen: vibrant or cool color palettes are requested
feminine or soft-focus aesthetics are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-shot portrait of a muscular man in a dark fedora, leaning against a weathered, peeling plaster wall. The lighting is directional, creating deep shadows and highlighting physical definition, while the color palette is dominated by warm ochre, sienna, and deep browns.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject skin tone harmonizing with the warm, distressed wall texture
High-contrast lighting defining muscular anatomy and facial features
The dark fedora providing a sharp silhouette against the lighter background
Text placement in the upper left quadrant balancing the subject's rightward lean
coreInvariants: Strong directional key light from the right

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the right two-thirds of the frame, leaning forward towards the viewer.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the dark brim of the fedora.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye enters at the subject's face, follows the line of the arm downward, then moves to the typography in the upper left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper left quadrant provides breathing room for the primary typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm ochre and sienna (background and skin highlights)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep charcoal and black (fedora, shadows, and tattoos)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast in the lighting.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'Y' features a wide, flat top
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a heavy, wide geometric sans with a light, tracked-out serif.
graphicDevices: Subtle outer glow on primary text

preserve: Horizontal expansion of the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the squared-off, wide geometric feel of the primary text
Provides the classic, high-contrast serif look for the subtitle

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a medium shot of a muscular man with tattoos wearing a black fedora, leaning against a sun-drenched, peeling plaster wall. Use a warm sepia color grade with strong side lighting from the right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary title in an ultra-expanded geometric sans-serif in the upper left, using a dark brown gradient. Place the subtitle in a light, tracked-out serif directly underneath.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting directional and high-contrast?
Is the color palette restricted to warm earth tones?
Is the primary text horizontally expanded?
Does the background show visible texture and distress?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check for anatomical correctness in the muscular definition
Ensure the fedora silhouette is sharp
Verify the text is legible against the textured background
Confirm the warm color harmony is maintained
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Masculine Portrait + Distressed Architectural Texture + Warm Sepia Grade + Expanded Geometric Typography
